bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 141K on YouTube, and the only offer I could find is free.
beats.text: Your Whop, Rockstarr Traders Academy, has one product: Free Access, with 216 members. I couldn't find a paid mentorship anywhere public. That's a big audience with no paid next step to take.

beats.title: 327 videos, and your last upload was a year ago.
beats.text: Your channel still promises new videos every week, and people still find “Forex Pips Explained” (20K views) and your live NAS100 breakdowns. Those viewers are ready for a next step. Right now there isn't one.

beats.title: Both of your websites say “Account has been blocked”.
beats.text: teachmetotrade.info, the link on your YouTube channel, and rstacademy.com both open a systeme.io page that only says “Account has been blocked”. Everyone who clicks from a video lands there.

beats.title: “I'm focused on EMG right now.” That's why it's built.
beats.text: The funnel doesn't need you posting daily. One page, a short application, and calls on a calendar you control. Your YouTube library keeps sending people, and you only talk to the ones who applied.
beats.quote: “Now I'm giving you what no one gave me — the truth, the strategy, and a real shot at freedom!”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Rico

preCallEmails.subject: Signals didn't make me a trader
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Back in 2015 I was chasing signals and auto traders. None of it built anything.

What changed was learning one plan and following it: one market, fixed risk, and a review after every trade.

That's what the academy is built on.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Rico

preCallEmails.subject: "I've lost money before"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people who apply have lost money before. That's usually why they apply.

The fix isn't a better signal. It's risk rules you follow and a plan that tells you when not to trade.

If you're worried about money, bring it up on the call. We'd rather tell you to wait than have you trade money you can't afford to lose.

Rico

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Rico

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Rico's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Rico

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Rico
